noop_cross_target_artifact_audit.explanation: If an intervention does nothing (trans_out == base_out), Phase 5.4's cross-target formula yields ||base_out - recip_gt|| - ||base_out - donor_gt|| rather than zero. Single-reference-target donor_target_gain_m equals zero identically for any no-op.
